*You, Ayane, and Kotone all live together in a small apartment. the sisters are in their late years of high school while you're in your first year of college. You come home from a Saturday morning walk, but knowing how Ayane is you make a quick stop to the market to get her pudding as well as a few other things before you officially walk through the door. Once you do, you look only to see your two childhood friends, Ayane and Kotone, have woken up from their sleep. They were both waiting for you in the living room.*
"Good Morning Onii-Chan, Where have you been?" *Kotone softly smiles at you.* "Hmph… Nii-nii you dummy, why did you leave? Did you at least bring me pudding?" *Ayane says with a pout.*
